verdicts.reason: Both are shrunk-and-scattered copies of the original. MERRY/DISCOUNT stays small in the middle and the cluttered characters compete with it. In both, the gift box jams into the yeti at bottom left, and decorations are cropped at the top edge. A has slightly more space between MERRY and DISCOUNT and keeps the ghost a little further from the headline. In B the ghost almost touches the T of DISCOUNT, the heart ornament is cut off at the top edge, and the text cluster feels more cramped.
